title: Start here
subtitle: Verify, get help, then choose your channels.
sections: Verify
Use the server's verification page to unlock the channels your roles allow.
Choose your channels
Open Your channels to show or hide eligible channels. Your roles and existing access still apply.
Need a person?
DM spoot. Your message reaches the person who runs it, and they can reply through spoot.
Find your way
This guide covers member commands, raid signups, automatic updates, recaps, Mythic+ and voice clips.

title: Member commands
subtitle: Type / in a server channel and choose a command.
sections: /progress
See Scrambled's current Heroic raid progress. Only you see the answer.
/poll
Create a Discord poll with 2–10 answers, a duration from 1 hour to 7 days, and optional multiple selections. Requires Create Polls.
/raid
Open current raid signups, rosters and attendance.
/clip
While in voice, start listening or save the funny thing that just happened. See the voice clips card.

title: Raid events
subtitle: Keep your signup current so organizers know who is coming.
sections: Find an event
Run /raid or use the signup posted in your raid channel.
Choose your signup
Use the event's buttons and menus to choose attendance, class and specialization where offered.
Change your plans
Return to the same event to update your signup. Check the displayed date and time before joining.
For organizers
Members with Manage Server can use /create for a guided form or /quickcreate for a single command.

title: Automatic raid updates
subtitle: First kills, milestones and team progress post automatically.
sections: First boss kills
spoot watches connected raid sources and announces qualifying first kills for each configured team.
Team channels
Progression, Meer's Raid and Saturday Raid keep their own destinations and progress.
Ahead of the Curve
Qualifying Heroic completion is announced with the team's progress.
No command needed
These updates run on a schedule. Existing posts and raid records keep their original dates and results.

title: Raid recaps
subtitle: The night's results, with a full scorecard on the website.
sections: Read the card
Open the recap posted to your team's channel for a summary of that raid night.
Open the full recap
Follow the link for damage, healing, deaths, damage taken and performance summaries.
Keep the date in view
A recap describes its reported raid night. Later corrections are dated on the card and in its text.
Separate teams
Progression, Meer's Raid and Saturday Raid have separate pages and delivery channels.

title: Mythic+
subtitle: Guild runs, weekly progress and records in one place.
sections: Weekly recap
Look in the Mythic+ bot channel for the weekly guild recap.
Full standings
Open the linked page for standings, rosters and source coverage.
Guild runs
The recap covers observed guild runs, timed keys and score growth.
New records
spoot posts qualifying guild records and keeps the records page up to date.

title: spoot's slash commands
subtitle: Seven slash commands. Permissions still apply.
sections: /progress · everyone
Shows Scrambled's current Heroic raid progress. Only you see the answer.
/raid · everyone
Opens raid signups, rosters and attendance for current events.
/poll · Create Polls
Creates a native Discord poll: 2–10 answers, 1 hour to 7 days, optional multiple selections.
/clip · voice members
Turns the last five seconds into a soundboard sound you name. First use starts listening.
/create · Manage Server
Creates a raid signup with a guided form for title, date, time, timezone and details.
/quickcreate · Manage Server
Creates a raid signup in one command, with title and date as options.
/setup · Manage Server
Connects the server to a WoW guild and chooses the channel and role for announcements.
How to run one
Type / in a channel and choose from spoot's commands. Discord hides commands you cannot use.

title: Voice clips
subtitle: Turn a funny moment into a soundboard sound.
sections: 1 · Start listening
Join voice and run /clip. spoot joins, posts a notice and says: spoot is now listening for slash clip commands.
2 · Catch the moment
Run /clip again. Only you see the reply with a clip.mp3 player and four buttons.
3 · Make it fit
Play the clip. Use A bit earlier or A bit later, then Add to soundboard and give it a name. Throw away discards it.
4 · Play it
Stay connected to voice. Open Soundboard below Voice Connected on desktop, or swipe up in the call on a phone. Click a sound to play it.
What is kept
Only the last 90 seconds stay in memory until someone clips them. spoot leaves when voice is empty or Stop listening is pressed.
Shared soundboard
Members can publish up to three new sounds per day. Administrators are exempt. Everyone can play sounds in voice.
